titleZh: 建造 ↔ 毀壞｜鷹架對拆遷球
hook: construct／erect 搭鷹架，demolish／raze／ruin 推拆遷球——工地廣播：今天蓋還是今天拆？請先看日曆。
script: 建造隊：construct／erect／fabricate／forge。毀壞隊：demolish／raze／ruin／wreck／devastate。口令：鷹架寫藍圖，拆遷球寫「此地無樓」。

members.speakLineEn: Workers can fabricate the metal brackets on-site, yet nobody should fabricate the safety logs.
members.speakLineZh: 工人可在現場製造金屬支架，但誰都不該捏造安全紀錄。

members.speakLineEn: In the hot forge, the blacksmith shaped a hinge that would outlast the wooden door itself.
members.speakLineZh: 在炙熱鍛造爐旁，鐵匠打出一枚比木門更耐用的鉸鏈。

members.speakLineEn: Students had one hour to assemble the robot chassis before the practice match began.
members.speakLineZh: 學生們有一小時組裝機器人底盤，然後練習賽就要開始。

members.speakLineEn: City planners voted to raze the condemned warehouse rather than patch its leaning walls.
members.speakLineZh: 市規劃者投票要摧毀那座危樓倉庫，而不是修補傾斜的牆。

members.speakLineEn: One careless cigarette nearly brought ruin to the century-old timber mill by the river.
members.speakLineZh: 一根隨意的香菸，幾乎把河邊百年木廠帶向毀滅。

members.speakLineEn: The flash flood would devastate the valley gardens before residents could sandbag the gates.
members.speakLineZh: 山洪會在居民來得及堆沙袋擋門前，摧毀山谷裡的園圃。

members.speakLineEn: Painters climbed the rattling scaffold to reach the mural high on the theater facade.
members.speakLineZh: 油漆工爬上晃動的鷹架，去夠戲院外牆上高處的壁畫。

members.speakLineEn: A yellow crane lifted steel beams over the street while traffic waited behind orange cones.
members.speakLineZh: 黃色吊車把鋼樑吊過街道，車流在橘色錐桶後等候。

members.speakLineEn: She strapped on her scratched helmet before pedaling into the morning bike-share lane.
members.speakLineZh: 她扣上刮痕累累的安全帽，才騎進早晨的共享單車道。

members.speakLineEn: He circled the audition date on the kitchen calendar and taped a reminder next to it.
members.speakLineZh: 他在廚房日曆上圈出試鏡日期，旁邊再貼一張提醒。

members.speakLineEn: Every visitor borrowed a bright hardhat before stepping onto the unfinished skywalk.
members.speakLineZh: 每位訪客都要借一頂鮮亮的工地帽，才能走上未完工的空中走廊。

pitfalls: fabricate 可=製造／也可=捏造，看語境
